newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's C.bank injects 50 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's C.bank injects 50 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 50 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Wednesday.

The bank received bids totalling 5.546 billion dirhams and allocated 3.800 billion dirhams at a 6.5 percent interest rate. That was more than the 3.750 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 68.52 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on May 31, 1997.
